contract.anchor: ## 2026-07-25 — UI-CONSOLIDATION-FOUNDATION-INTAKE-R1 — feat(ui): establish canonical visual foundation

active_phase.immediate_objective: Bounded intake of the approved external UI package into versioned ownership. NO product screen, database, Supabase, deployment or runtime surface was touched; js/** is byte-identical to 204b033. FIRST ATTEMPT HARD-STOPPED and is accepted as read-only reconciliation: the package alias block was sized against the design project .dc.html prototypes, not against this repository, so eleven --rv-* tokens consumed by js/screens had neither a canonical replacement nor an alias and no var() fallback exists anywhere, leaving 61 references across five product screens unresolvable. An amended order supplied the rulings applied here. TOKEN RULING: css/tokens.css is promoted with its deprecated block extended under an explicit LEGACY COMPATIBILITY heading holding exactly 26 transitional names - the package fifteen, three semantic aliases (--rv-font-size-label, --rv-font-size-body, --rv-color-chip-glyph) and eight legacy values retained verbatim (--rv-color-section-label, --rv-color-bg-header, --rv-color-chip-bg and the five --rv-status-*). The five --rv-status-* tokens are NOT mapped onto the new --rv-pill-* families and keep their current values; that mapping is a D4 decision owned by the property-based remediation phase. --rv-chip-glyph is added canonically. TARGETED CORRECTION (RESUME SAME MATERIAL PHASE, no new phase, starting HEAD c17f17b, ledger anchor '## 2026-07-25 - UI-CONSOLIDATION-FOUNDATION-INTAKE-R1 - fix(ui): close shorthand color ownership gap'): the intake's claim that the normative contract carried zero literal hex was unsound. scripts/ui-foundation/rules.mjs matched six-digit hex only, so the shorthand #fff in the primary-button row of UI_VISUAL_CONTRACT.md was never scanned. Corrected on exactly four paths. One canonical semantic token was added, --rv-text-on-brand: var(--rv-surface), in the BRAND / ACTION section, commented as contextual inverse text for brand-coloured surfaces and explicitly NOT a fifth text-hierarchy level, so the D3 four-level ceiling is not reopened; it aliases the surface token, so no second literal white value exists and --rv-surface remains the sole owner of that value. The contract's primary-button Text cell now reads --rv-text-on-brand and the contract carries zero literal hex in all four CSS forms (#rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa), proved by an all-form scan. HEX_RE now covers all four forms, longest-first so #rrggbbaa is not truncated; contract scanning was not weakened and no path was newly excluded. The token is declared but has NO runtime consumer yet; applying it to any surface belongs to the remediation phase. WORKTREE DEVIATION DISCLOSED: at re-entry the four authorized paths already carried uncommitted edits from an earlier interrupted run of the same order, matching its specification exactly, with an empty index, no commit and no path outside the authorized set or the declared protected residue; they were re-verified against the order rather than trusted. Result: 128 declarations (102 canonical, 26 deprecated), 0 unresolved runtime references, 335 references reported as debt. AUTHORITY LAYERS: css/tokens.css owns values; UI_VISUAL_CONTRACT.md v2 owns primitives, archetypes and closed enums; DESIGN_DECISIONS.md (append-only, promoted byte-identical, D1-D8 untouched) owns reasons; UI_CONFORMANCE.md owns screen mapping; SGAA_DESIGN_SYSTEM_REFERENCE.md owns provenance; ARCHITECT_BRIEF.md is a temporary execution brief and is NOT the permanent owner of visual rules. CONTRACT CORRECTION: the package contract inlined literal #64748b as the section-chip glyph while deleting the token that owned it. Section 2.4 now reads var(--rv-chip-glyph). The intake's accompanying zero-literal-hex claim held only for six-digit forms and is corrected by the TARGETED CORRECTION recorded in this objective. FIXTURE RULING: the two intake fixtures were byte-identical (852cd0e7631dfe1622bbf520885533a9036144f5029e9e37bc9aa7dd2034dd26), so only the primary is versioned and the copy stays in the external package, recorded as non-promoted in UI_CONFORMANCE.md. One shared support.js is versioned and loaded by both the fixture and the evidence document. The primary fixture is versioned but INTENTIONALLY NOT YET CONFORMED - it still carries literal hex and zero var(--rv-*) - so the phase-4 detector must not run against it. BRAND RULING: six SVGs promoted unmodified. inttex-favicon.svg and inttex-symbol.svg are byte-identical (e416f775aaf8543bc23a3c953ed7613b84afa6d0e2a0d8ec444ca40b4ca1a29a); the reuse is intentional and is disclosed in the promoted README with its hash. The README separates the native viewBox from the recommended rendered size. NO brand asset was applied to any runtime surface. VALIDATOR: scripts/validate-ui-foundation.mjs with traversal, parsing, rules and reporting in four separate modules - deterministic, no network, no LLM, no database, and explicitly NOT the phase-4 screen detector. It classifies every runtime token as canonical, deprecated or unknown; unknown fails, deprecated is reported with file and line as permitted debt. 31 focused tests include deliberate failing fixtures for every critical ownership rule, among them one negative fixture per CSS hex form (#fff, #ffff, #ffffff, #ffffffff), a passing case for var(--rv-text-on-brand), proof that literal colours stay legal inside css/tokens.css, and proof that the tests/** exclusion does not suppress contract findings. No second hex parser and no duplicated rule engine were introduced; the tests import the same modules the validator uses. GUARD RESCOPE: tests/manta-route-ui.smoke.js R3/20f guards the historical R3 Manta cache-bust and asserts no css changes. The architect explicitly amended the change boundary to include that file and authorized exactly one purely additive allowlist entry, /^css/tokens.css$/, beside the existing db/89, db/90 and css/responsive.css exceptions. Subject, comparison mechanism and baseline reference unchanged; no assertion weakened. VALIDATION: node scripts/validate-ui-foundation.mjs -> PASS errors=0 debt=335. node --test tests/ui-foundation-validator.test.mjs -> 31/31. Contract literal-hex scan, all four CSS forms -> 0 matches. node --test tests/*.js -> 4326 tests, 4325 pass / 1 fail, the sole failure the accepted external-corpus tests/g14-c-bridge-smoke.test.js at its byte-for-byte baseline condition, with no changed file in that domain. PHASE 3 NOT STARTED. PHASE 4 NOT STARTED. PHASE 5 NOT STARTED. Archetypes B-F remain CANDIDATE and may not be cited as precedent. The executor does not self-accept and no phase chains automatically.
